description: Sends one message from the candidate to the Modulos AI interviewer and returns the interviewer's reply. You are only the channel between the two. Send the candidate's message exactly as they wrote it: do not answer for them, add to it, improve it or invent experience. Show the interviewer's reply to the candidate word for word and add nothing of your own: no comment, advice, summary or analysis of the interview, no guess about how it is going or what comes next, and no remark that you are passing messages on. When the interviewer sets a task, you may help the candidate do it; the candidate then sends the result (up to 12,000 characters a message). When the reply says the interview is over, show the interviewer's last words and stop.

message.description: The candidate's message, exactly as they wrote it.

session.description: The session value returned by start_job_application. Keep it for the whole interview and do not show it to anyone else.

name: talk_to_interviewer
